requirements.text: The sample(s) of the ESA submitted for approval shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the samples for clear, indelible marking of trade name/mark and type designation.

requirements.text: If components sold as aftermarket equipment and intended for the installation in motor vehicles are not related to immunity related functions (see paragraph 2.12.), the manufacturer shall issue a declaration that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation and in particular the limits defined in paragraphs 6.5., 6.6., 6.7., 6.8. and 6.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the sales channel (OE vs aftermarket) and, if aftermarket, check for the manufacturer's declaration of compliance with the emission limits.

requirements.text: In case an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: If no approval number is given, check for a Technical Service test report on non-interchangeability with R37/R99/R128 light sources.

requirements.text: In case an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA.
requirements.test_case: Check the documentation for R37/R99/R128 approval numbers of any light source ESA.

requirements.text: The approval mark described in paragraph 5.3 shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check whether a UN R10 ESA approval exists for the lamp and inspect the approval mark on the ESA.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review EMC test reports or ESA approval for the lamp and verify it complies with UN R10 emission and immunity limits.

requirements.text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Perform or review ESA radiated and conducted emission and immunity tests per Annexes 6 to 10.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Radiated broadband emission test per Annex 7 / CISPR 25 on the representative ESA.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m, decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured emissions at 30-75 MHz with the 62-52 dBµV/m limit line.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Check measured emissions at 400-1000 MHz stay at or below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz band shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured emissions at 75-400 MHz with the 52-63 dBµV/m limit line.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm all measured values are below the limits.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Radiated narrowband emission test per Annex 8 on a representative ESA.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m, decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Check measured level 30-75 MHz against 52-42 dBuV/m limit.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Check measured level 400-1000 MHz stays below 53 dBuV/m.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limit in the 75 to 400 MHz band shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Check measured level 75-400 MHz against 42-53 dBuV/m limit.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured emissions with limit lines of Appendix 7.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall have its emission tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Run the ISO 7637-2 transient emission test per Annex 10 on a representative ESA and compare the results with Table 1.

requirements.text: The negative transient pulse amplitude emitted by the ESA shall not exceed -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the nominal supply voltage, then measure negative transient pulses per ISO 7637-2 and check that they stay at or above -100 V.

requirements.text: The negative transient pulse amplitude emitted by the ESA shall not exceed -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the nominal supply voltage, then measure negative transient pulses per ISO 7637-2 and check that they stay at or above -450 V.

requirements.text: The positive transient pulse amplitude emitted by the ESA shall not exceed +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the nominal supply voltage, then measure positive transient pulses per ISO 7637-2 and check that they stay at or below +150 V.

requirements.text: The positive transient pulse amplitude emitted by the ESA shall not exceed +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the nominal supply voltage, then measure positive transient pulses per ISO 7637-2 and check that they stay at or below +75 V.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall have its immunity to electromagnetic radiation tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Check the EMC immunity test report per Annex 9 for the lamp ESA.

requirements.text: The ESA immunity minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be tested at the minimum test levels given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the minimum test levels in the report against Table 2b.

requirements.text: The ESA immunity test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band shall be tested at the test levels given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test levels in the report against Table 2a over 90% of 20-6000 MHz.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Monitor the lamp function during the immunity test for any degradation.

requirements.text: For the starting profile test, which is applicable only to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12 V/24 V starter motor, the ESA representative of this type shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1, at the test levels given in Table 3a.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the intended vehicle powertrain and supply voltage; if combustion engine installation is possible, check the starting profile test report against Table 3a.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall apply the Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report classifies the functional status per ISO 7637-1 for each pulse.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall be tested with test pulse 1 at an immunity test level of -75 V (12 V system) and -450 V (24 V system) for 500 pulses, with functional performance status classification III for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Apply 500 pulses of test pulse 1 at the level for the supply voltage and verify the required FPSC class III.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall be tested with test pulse 2a at an immunity test level of +37 V (12 V and 24 V systems) for 500 pulses, with functional performance status classification I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Apply 500 pulses of test pulse 2a at +37 V and verify the FPSC class: I for immunity related functions, III for others.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall be tested with test pulse 2b at an immunity test level of +10 V (12 V system) and +20 V (24 V system) for 10 pulses, with functional performance status classification II for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 pulses of test pulse 2b at the level for the supply voltage and verify the FPSC class: II for immunity related functions, III for others.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall be tested with test pulse 3a at an immunity test level of -112 V (12 V system) and -150 V (24 V system) for 1 h, with functional performance status classification I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Apply test pulse 3a for 1 h at the level for the supply voltage and verify the FPSC class: I for immunity related functions, III for others.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall be tested with test pulse 3b at an immunity test level of +75 V (12 V system) and +150 V (24 V system) for 1 h, with functional performance status classification I for immunity related functions and III for functions not related to immunity related functions.
requirements.test_case: Apply test pulse 3b for 1 h at the level for the supply voltage and verify the FPSC class: I for immunity related functions, III for others.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of this type shall have its immunity tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Review the EMC test report for ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b and the ISO 16750-2 starting profile at the Table 3a/3b levels.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the broadband electromagnetic emissions test on ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report cites CISPR 25 as the method.

requirements.text: If the test is not performed with a REESS, the ESA should be tested at rated current.
requirements.test_case: Check the supply current during the test equals the rated current.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp is energised in normal operation, preferably at maximum load, during the test.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid, the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows ALSE per CISPR 25 clause 6.4.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via defined impedance.
requirements.test_case: Check the test setup photos or report for the ESA case grounding to the ground plane.

requirements.text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), an open area test site (OATS) used for the test shall comply with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report for the site type and CISPR 16-1-4 compliance if an OATS was used.

requirements.text: Ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
requirements.test_case: Check the report contains ambient measurements taken before or after the main test.

requirements.text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.test_case: Verify ambient noise is at least 6 dB below the limits.

requirements.text: The limits of Annex 7 shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the sweep covers 30-1000 MHz.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for measurements of radiated broadband electromagnetic emissions, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Check the detector type in the test report and that a 20 dB correction was applied if peak detectors were used.

requirements.text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
requirements.test_case: Check the instrument type and the continuous recording if FFT was used.

requirements.text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
requirements.test_case: Check that the video bandwidth is at least 3 times the RBW.

requirements.text: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
requirements.test_case: Check for a minimum 1 s measurement time per band if FFT was used.

requirements.text: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver.
requirements.test_case: Check the report lists a spectrum analyser or scanning receiver.

requirements.text: The measurements shall use the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
requirements.test_case: Compare RBW, step and dwell settings with Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, the Technical Service shall make investigations to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
requirements.test_case: If a limit exceedance occurs, review the ambient background measurement to confirm whether the source is the ESA or background radiation.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Perform the broadband emission measurement per CISPR 12 across 30-1000 MHz at the specified intervals and compare with the ESA limits.

requirements.text: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Check the antenna phase centre is aligned with the harness centre in the setup.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
requirements.test_case: Check the setup photos for the LV harness nearest the antenna.

requirements.text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report: the maximum reading relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical) in each of the 14 bands is taken as the characteristic reading.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Check test report cites CISPR 25 procedure.

requirements.text: The radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions test of the ESA shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify ALSE test per CISPR 25 6.4 in the report.

requirements.text: As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE), the open area test site (OATS) used for the test shall comply with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: If OATS used, check site validation to CISPR 16-1-4.

requirements.text: Except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions, the extraneous noise or signal in the ambient measurement shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify ambient levels are at least 6 dB below limits.

requirements.text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, the ambient measurement shall be taken before or after the main test.
requirements.test_case: Check ambient measurement is recorded before or after main test.

requirements.text: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Check sweep covers 30-1000 MHz.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check detector setting in test report.

requirements.text: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2.
requirements.test_case: Check instrument parameters against Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with average detector, the scanning receiver used for the measurements shall have a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz.
requirements.test_case: If receiver used, check BW 120 kHz at -6 dB.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with average detector, the spectrum analyser used for the measurements shall have an RBW at -3 dB of 100/120 kHz.
requirements.test_case: If analyser used, check RBW 100/120 kHz at -3 dB.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the scanning receiver used for the measurements shall have a maximum step size of 60 kHz.
requirements.test_case: If receiver used, check step size at most 60 kHz.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the scanning receiver used for the measurements shall have a minimum dwell time of 5 ms.
requirements.test_case: If receiver used, check dwell time at least 5 ms.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, the spectrum analyser used for the measurements shall have a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz.
requirements.test_case: If analyser used, check scan time at least 100 ms/MHz.

requirements.text: If the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, and the Technical Service divides the frequency range into 14 frequency bands, the Technical Service shall perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.
requirements.test_case: If used, check ISO 17025 data and 14-frequency confirmation tests.

requirements.text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
requirements.test_case: If limit exceeded, check investigation of background vs ESA source.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Check test frequency intervals per CISPR 12 across 30-1000 MHz.

requirements.text: In each of the 14 frequency bands, the maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.test_case: If 14 bands used, check max of horizontal/vertical readings per band.

requirements.text: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report refers to ISO 11452-1 conditions.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Check the setup against the Annex 9 arrangement.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the lamps are operated in a normal mode during the test.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the lamps are powered on during the test.

requirements.text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
requirements.test_case: Check the lab calibration records for no extraneous equipment.

requirements.text: During calibration, no extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point.
requirements.test_case: Check the calibration setup for 1 m clearance from the reference point.

requirements.text: To ensure reproducible measurement results when tests and measurements are repeated, the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
requirements.test_case: Compare the test and calibration layouts.

requirements.text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
requirements.test_case: Check the unit configuration and harness length in the test setup.

requirements.text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs.
requirements.test_case: Verify PM2 modulation in the report.

requirements.text: In the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth.
requirements.test_case: Verify AM 1 kHz 80% modulation in the report.

requirements.text: In the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs.
requirements.test_case: Verify PM3 modulation in the report.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the report covers 20-6000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 steps.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the step size and dwell time in the report.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the Technical Service tested at the ISO 11452-1 intervals.

requirements.text: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, the failure shall be verified as having occurred under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
requirements.test_case: If a failure occurs, verify the field generation was controlled.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Check the polarization in the report.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall use the "substitution method" to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Check the ISO 11452-2 substitution method in the report.

requirements.text: Depending on the ESA to be tested, the Technical Service shall choose the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report for the chosen maximum-coupling configuration in the TEM cell.

requirements.text: The TEM cell test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: Run the TEM cell immunity test per ISO 11452-3 or confirm another permitted method was used.

requirements.text: As an alternative, the ESA tested while installed in the vehicle shall be tested according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the BCI test was done in-vehicle per ISO 11451-4 with a 150 mm substitution probe.

requirements.text: The ESA immunity test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA; or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Perform the BCI test per ISO 11452-4 with the 150 mm substitution or 900 mm closed-loop probe position.

requirements.text: For the BCI test method using the closed-loop method with power limitation, the HV/LV wiring harness shall be straight over its entire length.
requirements.test_case: Check that the harness is straight over its entire length in the setup.

requirements.text: When using closed loop method, unless otherwise specified, the length of the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 1,000 mm (+200/-0 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the LV harness length in the closed-loop setup (1000 +200/-0 mm).

requirements.text: When using substitution method, for all test methods defined in part 4 of ISO 11452 except the BCI test method using the closed-loop method with power limitation, the HV/LV wiring harness shall be straight over at least 1,400 mm starting at the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Check that the harness is straight for at least 1400 mm from the ESA in the test setup.

requirements.text: When using substitution method, unless otherwise specified, the length of the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 1,700 mm (+300/-0 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the LV harness length in the BCI substitution setup (1700 +300/-0 mm).

requirements.text: All of the harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr≤1.4), at (50 ± 5) mm above the ground plane.
requirements.test_case: Check the harness is on material with εr≤1.4 at 50±5 mm above the ground plane.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the test shall be performed with the injection probe placed around the low voltage harness.
requirements.test_case: Check that the injection probe is around the LV harness in the BCI setup.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, if applicable, the test shall be performed with the injection probe placed around the DC power lines.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring and whether a probe was placed around the DC power lines.

requirements.text: The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: Perform the stripline test per ISO 11452-5 if this method is chosen.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Perform the reverberation chamber test per ISO 11452-11 if this method is chosen.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
requirements.test_case: Check that the reverberation chamber setup uses a ground plane.

requirements.text: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Check that the test report follows the Annex 10 method for both immunity and emission.

requirements.text: For ESAs that are not exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor), the immunity test of ESAs for transients conducted along 12/24 V supply lines shall apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines and verify the lamp function during and after the test.

requirements.text: The immunity test of ESAs for transients conducted along 12/24 V supply lines shall apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the supply lines and connected inputs, then verify the lamp function is unaffected.

requirements.text: The emission measurement of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be made according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient emissions on the supply lines and other connections per ISO 7637-2 and record the pulse amplitudes.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp for a marking space of sufficient size.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check and rub test of markings.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension a of the approval mark (>=5 mm).

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2., shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check marking placement against the approval documents.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of front or rear position lamps and front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the approval mark includes an arrow and that it points outward.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in the case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check approval for reduced distribution and arrow direction.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the approval mark.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), shall bear a marking indicating also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Check approval for LED substitute light sources and marking.

requirements.text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Check whether light sources are replaceable; if so check category marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a secondary operating mode.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for a secondary operating mode and, if present, check that the voltage marking is on the lamp.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with a variable luminous intensity control.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for variable intensity control and, if present, check that the voltage marking is on the lamp.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for an electronic light source control gear and, if present, check that the rated voltage or voltage range is marked on the lamp.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each lamp for a legible rated voltage (6V, 12V or 24V) or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp bears rated voltage marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Check lamp bears the module identification code.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Check module rated voltage marking.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check if LED modules are replaceable and bear trade mark.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the specific identification code of the light source module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1.
requirements.test_case: Check module identification code MD + approval mark.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check for external control gear and its marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking location on the lamp.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Check marking visibility on the vehicle.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the lens is detachable; if so both parts are marked.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Check that each body bears only its function's approval marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that markings are on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.test_case: Check module markings if modules are replaceable.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Check combined mark component sizes against minimum sizes.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify conformity of the lamp to paragraphs 4 and 5 via type approval test report.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp against the R48 paragraph 5 and 6 requirements in force at application.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the R48 requirements per lamp function for M1 and verify those testable at approval.

requirements.text: In normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which the lamps may be subjected in such use, the lamps shall be so designed and constructed that their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Vibration test followed by photometric and functional check.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check design for shared light sources between the functions and for multiple sources or tell-tale provision.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, a note shall be made within the communication document.
requirements.test_case: Check the communication document for the required note if the functions are reciprocally incorporated.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., the manufacturer logo incorporated in a lamp shall be only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and drawings for a logo and the applicant's request.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the logo's light emitting surface along the reference axis, which must be at most 100 cm2.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, where a manufacturer logo is incorporated in a lamp, the applicant shall confirm this by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)).
requirements.test_case: Check for a logo and, if present, for the applicant's statement.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection that no logo is present in the stop or reversing lamp.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review circuit diagram for how LED groups are wired.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, under option (a) the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Switch off each light source in turn and measure intensity against the Annex 3 minimum values.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, under option (a) when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded.
requirements.test_case: Measure maximum intensity with all light sources lit and compare with the function maxima.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, under option (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced.
requirements.test_case: Disconnect one light source and check that the failure tell-tale signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, under option (b) the communication form shall contain a note stating that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Check the communication form for the note about use only on vehicles with a failure tell-tale if option (b) is used.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2, a rear end-outline marker lamp category RM2, a stop lamp category S2 or S4, a direction indicator of category 2b, or a rear fog lamp of category F2, the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp category and simulate control failure to verify steady intensity.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Check documentation of the light source type and its approval or non-replaceable status.

requirements.text: In case a light source category or categories or type(s) is restricted for use in lamps on vehicles in use and originally equipped with such lamps, the applicant for type approval of the lamp shall declare that the lamp is only intended for installation on those vehicles, and this shall be noted in the communication form.
requirements.test_case: Check the declaration and communication form note if restricted sources are used.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for replaceable sources and verify they cannot be fitted wrongly.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, and the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applies.
requirements.test_case: Check holder conformity to IEC 60061 data sheets if replaceable sources are used.

requirements.text: Light signalling devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: EMC test for radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Check modules cannot be interchanged with other sources in the same housing.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Check module fitting and removal needs a tool and only the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module design for tamper resistance.

requirements.text: When the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Swap in a module with the same identification code and repeat photometry.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
requirements.test_case: Use standard light sources per R.E.5 for measurements if replaceable sources are used.

requirements.text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure standard source luminous flux at test voltage, within 5 per cent of reference.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric measurements with the lamp's own LED sources fitted.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
requirements.test_case: Sum the separate measurement results and compare with limits.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Identify source types per function and measure separately per condition.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Check the goniometer setup masks stray reflections.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions, the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's installation position field and repeat photometry at extremes.

requirements.text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Check the application; if requested, repeat measurements with the substitute LED sources.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Confirm intensities are measured with the source continuously lit.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test distance satisfies the inverse square law.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
requirements.test_case: Check the receiver angular aperture is between 10 arcmin and 1 degree.

requirements.text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
requirements.test_case: Check the intensity is met within a quarter degree of the direction of observation.

requirements.text: For a light-signalling lamp other than a rear-registration plate illuminating lamp, the limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Determine the apparent surface in the reference axis direction from drawings and measurement.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Run photometric tests at 13.5 V for 12 V systems.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check the application documents for a control gear and operate as specified.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the absence of control gear and operate the lamp as the applicant specifies.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity in all visible directions and compare with the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer measurement of intensity on the HV axis for both samples against the paragraph 5 table minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities in the Annex 3 directions and compare with the figure values.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure off-axis intensities and compare with the Annex 3 percentages times the table minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity across the Annex 2 visibility angles against the table minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed in the light intensity measurement of the two samples supplied.
requirements.test_case: Apply the Annex 3 local variation provisions during the photometric measurement of both samples.

requirements.text: If the applicant requests an additional test to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No.48, the lamp shall show that in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction, the maximum intensity is not more than 2.5∙10-1cd.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the applicant requested it; if so, measure at 165°-180° outboard.

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check the application for interdependent declarations and test them together.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Check the electronics for variable intensity control; measure the range.

requirements.text: For other systems, under standard conditions (good visibility with meteorological optical range MOR greater than 2,000 m and clean lens), the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the control and measure maxima under standard conditions.

requirements.text: For systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, under night-time conditions, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the control and measure night-time maxima.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity ratio of at least 5:1 within ±5°V and ±10°H.

requirements.text: If one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain more than one light source and is or are considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Measure with all sources operating.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Perform luminous intensity tests per Annex 8.

requirements.text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Verify colour with the lamp's installed light sources.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined in Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visual and colorimetric inspection outside the grid.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement within the Annex 3 grid.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8 shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Apply the paragraph 4.8 procedure for colour measurement.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.test_case: Check the light source technologies and test each.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test of two lamp samples against Table 4 values.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp and rear end-outline marker lamp shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of intensity at the Table 4 grid angles and check of geometric visibility.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp and rear end-outline marker lamp shall comply with the failure provisions in paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Check the 4.6 failure provisions (e.g. behaviour under single LED failure) by document review and a test.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) and rear end-outline marker lamps (RM1, RM2) shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates and compare to the red colour region.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of stop lamps (S1, S2, S3, S4, MS) supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of two stop lamp samples against Table 7 intensity values.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity within the Table 7 visibility angles.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of emitted light and check them against the red colour region.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Check the intended installation (single or pair) in the application documents; if pair-only, measure at least 25 cd up to 30° inwards.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two reversing lamp samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of two reversing lamp samples against Table 10 intensities.

requirements.text: When the type approval is granted applying the pair-installation condition, the reversing lamp device shall only be installed in a pair, as stated in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1).
requirements.test_case: Check paragraph 9.1.3 of the communication form and the vehicle installation to confirm the lamp is fitted only in a pair.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the emitted light and check they fall within the white region.

requirements.text: The front/rear direction indicator (11, 11a, 11b, 11c, 12) shall provide minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 20° inboard and 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above and 15° below (15°/5° under note b), as set out in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Determine the function of the upper row; if so, check geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: The rear direction indicator (2a, 2b) shall provide minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 80° outboard (20°/80° under note a) and minimum vertical angles of 15° above and 15° below (15°/5° under note b), with (5°/15°) under note c, as set out in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Determine the function of the upper row; if it is a direction indicator, measure geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: The front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) shall provide minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 80° outboard (20°/80° under note a) and minimum vertical angles of 15° above and 15° below (15°/5° under note b), with (5°/15°) under note c, as set out in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation drawing and visibility angles against Table A2-1.

requirements.text: The stop lamps (S1, S2) shall provide minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard and 45° outboard (20°/45° under note a) and minimum vertical angles of 15° above and 15° below (15°/5° under note b), with (5°/15°) under note c, as set out in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility angles against Table A2-1 on the installation drawing.

requirements.text: The minimum intensities expressed as percentages of the minimum intensities required, read from Figures A3-I to A3-XV, shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Check that the minimum intensity values are rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: Where one of the lamps listed in (a) to (f) is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the specified mounting height; if ≤750 mm, verify photometry down to 5°.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light pattern should be substantially uniform, i.e. the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of the reversing lamp against the grid minimum values.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually examine the lamp; if local variations are seen, check that intensity between measurement directions is at least 50% of the lower minimum.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity after 1 min and 10 min of operation.

requirements.text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stability.

requirements.text: Operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.test_case: Determine the function; if a direction indicator, test in flashing mode at 1.5 Hz and 50% duty.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of a lamp (function) shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test report against the Table A8-1 time points.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2 are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the paragraph 1.2 measurements are compliant.

requirements.text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: Review the run-up behaviour in the photometric test; if doubtful, test through to stability.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device and drawings for a marking space of sufficient size.

requirements.text: All markings required on the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check of the markings and a rub test with water and petrol to confirm indelibility.

requirements.text: The sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2. shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample to confirm the sequential number sits next to the approval mark.

requirements.text: When the Unique Identifier is used in place of the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2., the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: Check whether a Unique Identifier is used and, if so, that its format matches Figure I.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's rotation-angle specification and whether TOP is marked on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection of the markings on the device.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark for grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the combined approval mark components against the smallest minimum size required by the individual regulations.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Document check of compliance with referenced R48 requirements.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Review the applicable requirements against type approval test report.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection and sample examination.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Durability and endurance tests; visual inspection.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt manual dismantling without tools; inspect design.

requirements.text: Any protuberances that retro-reflective devices exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspect ribbed area for cleanability.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough.
requirements.test_case: Visual and tactile inspection of the outer surface.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp to confirm no access to the inner surface.

requirements.text: Where retro-reflectors consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, they shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Check design drawing for a separate filter and verify non-separability.

requirements.text: Retro-reflecting optical units and filters shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.test_case: Document check that the colour is from material mass, not coating.

requirements.text: The night-time colour test specifications of paragraph 4.2.1 shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the colour; if red, apply the night colour test.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°, or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, at an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Illuminate with Illuminant A at 1/3° divergence and measure colour.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates against R48 limits.

requirements.text: White retro-reflective devices shall not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates x and y of Standard Illuminant A used to illuminate the retro-reflective device shall not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Measure x,y shift of Illuminant A after reflection (≤0.01).

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the class and check dimensions and shape against Annex 5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Photometric RI and colour measurement per 5.1.4 and 5.1.5.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Run the Annex 6 and 7 tests on the samples.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Heat test per Annex 6 Part 1, then measure colour and RI at 20'.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Full photometric test per 5.1.4 on the min and max samples.

requirements.text: The two samples in the first group shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 2 and Annex 7 Parts 1 and 2 tests.

requirements.text: The two samples in the fourth group shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test.

requirements.text: The two samples in the second group shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Annex 6 Parts 4 and 5 tests.

requirements.text: The two samples in the third group shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Annex 4 Part 3 stability test.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure trichromatic coordinates after the tests.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI after the tests.

requirements.text: The RI verification of the retro-reflectors in each group shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: RI at 20' and β=0°, or all positions if necessary.

requirements.text: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometry for each specified reference axis.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements of a Class IA or IB retro-reflective device, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter shall be considered.
requirements.test_case: Check the illuminating surface within a 200 mm circle.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface used for photometric measurements of a Class IA or IB retro-reflective device shall be limited to 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the area used for photometry.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for amber Class IA and IB retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3 (1.25∙101, 7∙100 and 6.25∙100 mcd·lx-1 in the first three columns) for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 1°30' against Table 3.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for amber Class IA and IB retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3 (7.50∙102, 5.00∙102 and 2.50∙102 mcd·lx-1 in the first three columns) for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20' against Table 3.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red Class IA and IB retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3 (5∙100, 2.8∙100 and 2.5∙100 mcd·lx-1 in the first three columns) for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 1°30' against Table 3.
