requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red Class IA and IB retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3 (3.00∙102, 2.00∙102 and 1.00∙102 mcd·lx-1 in the first three columns) for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20' against Table 3.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for white Class IA and IB retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3 (2.0∙101, 1.12∙101 and 1.0∙101 mcd·lx-1 in the first three columns) for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 1°30' against Table 3.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for white Class IA and IB retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3 (1.20∙103, 8.00∙102 and 4.00∙102 mcd·lx-1 in the first three columns) for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20' against Table 3.

requirements.text: The RI values of a Class IA or IB retro-reflector intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting height and limit RI verification to 5° downwards if below 750 mm.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Colour test per 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector device shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Check trichromatic coordinates against the UN R48 limits.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector samples a to j submitted for testing shall be subjected to the tests in the chronological order set out in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
requirements.test_case: Run the Table 4 test sequence on samples a to j.

requirements.text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0° and a mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Take reading at β1=-5°, β2=0° if mirror effect occurs.

requirements.text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
requirements.test_case: During RI measurement at 0°, turn device slightly to check for mirror effect.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.
requirements.test_case: Position device at corresponding ε for other angle measurements.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Rotate about reference axis to minimum RI and compare to the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: The RI of a retro-reflective device marked "TOP" must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.test_case: Verify RI stays above the minimum throughout ±5° rotation.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
requirements.test_case: Check for TOP marking; if present rotate ±5° and measure RI.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: If RI at ε=0° exceeds spec by 50%, measure all angles at ε=0°.

requirements.text: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the goniometer setup follows the CIE system.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Check the lab source is CIE Illuminant A.

requirements.text: The angular diameter of the illuminated area (η) shall not exceed 80'.
requirements.test_case: Verify illuminated area angular diameter ≤80'.

requirements.text: The angular diameter of the measuring device (γ) shall not exceed 10'.
requirements.test_case: Verify receiver angular diameter ≤10'.

requirements.text: The angular diameter of the source (δ) shall not exceed 10'.
requirements.test_case: Verify source angular diameter ≤10'.

requirements.text: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above and illustrated in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
requirements.test_case: Check distance is ≥10 m and meets δ, γ, η limits.

requirements.text: A measuring element used to check the uniformity of illuminance shall have a sensitive area not greater than one-tenth of the area to be examined.
requirements.test_case: Check the sensor area ≤1/10 of the examined area.

requirements.text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light, shall be sufficiently uniform.
requirements.test_case: Measure illuminance uniformity over the useful area.

requirements.text: The variation in the value of the illuminance shall comply with the condition max/min ≤ 1.05.
requirements.test_case: Verify max/min illuminance ≤1.05.

requirements.text: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
requirements.test_case: Check photometer calibration to the V(λ) response.

requirements.text: If the photometer head shows a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture, suitable provisions shall be added, e.g. the application of a diffusing window at a certain distance in front of the sensitive surface.
requirements.test_case: If the head sensitivity varies, verify a diffusing window is used.

requirements.text: The photometer head shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometer aperture sensitivity is uniform.

requirements.text: The background to the sample and the framework of the sample holder should be matt black.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample background and holder are matt black.

requirements.text: The field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible.
requirements.test_case: Check the field of view and light spread are restricted.

requirements.text: Reflections from the floor and walls which occur over the relatively long test distances used shall be screened from both the sample and the photometer head by baffles.
requirements.test_case: Verify baffles screen floor and wall reflections.

requirements.text: Correction of residual stray light should always be allowed for by measuring it when the sample is covered by an opaque matt black surface, zigzag folded black paper of the same size and shape or a specular black surface suitably oriented with a light trap.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows residual stray light measured with a black cover and zigzag paper or light trap.

requirements.text: The residual stray light value shall be subtracted from that measured on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Review the photometric data to confirm the stray light value was subtracted.

requirements.text: Sufficient time should always be allowed for the apparatus to stabilize before commencing measurements.
requirements.test_case: Verify the warm-up and stabilization time is documented before measurement.

requirements.text: The laboratory ambient temperature should not vary significantly during the period of the test.
requirements.test_case: Check the laboratory temperature record over the test period.

requirements.text: The light source and photometer head should remain stable throughout the period of the test.
requirements.test_case: Check the stability logs of the source and photometer head during testing.

requirements.text: For testing the daytime colour and luminance factor of the material, illumination by CIE Standard Illuminant D65 (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) using geometry (45a:0) shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the class and colour requirements; if applicable, measure with D65 in 45/0 geometry.

requirements.text: If a monochromator is used for daytime colour measurement, the stepwise resolution Δλ shall be not larger than 10 nm.
requirements.test_case: Check the monochromator step resolution is 10 nm or less.

requirements.text: If similar simulation spectra are used instead of the D65 illuminant, the quality of the D65 simulation shall be assessed by the method described in ISO 23603:2005(E)/CIE S 012/E:2004.
requirements.test_case: Check the D65 simulation quality assessment per ISO 23603.

requirements.text: Measurements of daytime colour shall be done with a spectrophotometer in accordance with the provisions of Publication CIE 15:2004, Recommendations on Colorimetry - Second Edition.
requirements.test_case: Check the spectrophotometer measurement report against CIE 15:2004.

requirements.text: Measurements of daytime colour using a spectrophotometer shall illuminate the sample with CIE Standard Illuminant D65 (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) at an angle 45º to the normal and view it along the normal (geometry 45/0), either illuminated polychromatically or with a monochromator providing stepwise the CIE Standard Illuminant D65.
requirements.test_case: Verify the illuminant and geometry in the colour test setup.

requirements.text: In addition, the apertures of the light source and the receiver shall have sufficient dimensions in proportion to distances to ensure compliance with the above-mentioned recommendations.
requirements.test_case: Check the aperture dimensions against the distances in the instrument.

requirements.text: The measurement area shall be at least minimum 4.0 cm².
requirements.test_case: Measure the sample area to confirm it is at least 4.0 cm².

requirements.text: The receiver shall uniformly collect and evaluate all radiation reflected within a cone with its axis on the normal to the sampling aperture, apex at the centre of the sampling aperture, and a half angle of 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the receiver half angle of 5° in the instrument.

requirements.text: The sampling aperture shall be irradiated uniformly from all directions between two circular cones with their axes normal to the sampling aperture and apices at the centre of the sampling aperture, the smaller of the cones having a half angle of 40° and the larger of 50°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the illumination cone angles of 40° and 50° in the instrument.

requirements.text: The spectral distribution of the illuminant shall be in category BC (CIELAB) or better.
requirements.test_case: Check the illuminant is category BC (CIELAB) or better.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visual shape check at a 10 m observation distance.

requirements.text: The light emitting surface of the retro-reflective device of Class IVA must be at least 25 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the reflector class on the drawing or approval mark, then measure the light-emitting surface area (at least 25 cm2 if Class IVA).

requirements.text: Compliance with the above specifications of Annex 5 paragraph 3 shall be verified by visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Once the class is established, visually inspect the reflector against the Annex 5 paragraph 3 specifications.

requirements.text: After the 48-hour heat exposure, the sample of the retro-reflective device shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h heat exposure, cool the sample 1 h at 23±2 °C per Annex 6 Part 1.

requirements.text: In the test procedure for moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Keep the sample 48 h at 65 ±2 °C in dry air, then check for distortion and re-check photometric and colorimetric performance.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, the retro-reflective device shall show no cracking or appreciable distortion and, in particular, no cracking or appreciable distortion of its optical component.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect for cracking or distortion after the heat test.

requirements.text: After turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom, the water immersion test shall be repeated with the rear face covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Turn the device 180° and repeat with the rear face under about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: Immediately after the 50 °C immersion, retro-reflective devices or sample units of retro-reflective marking shall be immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately immerse in 25±5 °C water under the same conditions.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices, whether part of a lamp or not, or sample units of retro-reflective marking, shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Immerse 10 min in 50±5 °C water with the illuminating surface 20 mm below the surface.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices, whether part of a lamp or not, or sample units of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts before the water immersion test.
requirements.test_case: Strip removable parts before the water immersion test.

requirements.text: During the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface for water after the immersion test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect; record a fail if water is clearly present.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the RI of retro-reflectors shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: Lightly shake off water and measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Check the test request or report for the chosen water-resistance method.

requirements.text: The centreline of the nozzle(s) of the water spray cabinet shall be directed downward at an angle of 45° ± 5° to the vertical axis of a rotating test platform.
requirements.test_case: Measure that the nozzle axis is at 45°±5° to the vertical.

requirements.text: The water spray cabinet shall be equipped with a nozzle(s) which provides a solid cone water spray of sufficient angle to completely cover the sample device.
requirements.test_case: Check that the spray cabinet nozzle gives a solid cone covering the sample.

requirements.text: The rotating test platform shall have a minimum diameter of 140 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure that the platform diameter is at least 140 mm.

requirements.text: The rotating test platform shall rotate about a vertical axis in the centre of the cabinet.
requirements.test_case: Check that the platform rotates about the cabinet's central vertical axis.

requirements.text: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device, as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform, shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min.
requirements.test_case: Measure precipitation of 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min with the collector.

requirements.text: The vertical cylindrical collector used to measure the precipitation rate shall have a height of 100 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check that the collector height is 100 mm.

requirements.text: The vertical cylindrical collector used to measure the precipitation rate shall have an inside diameter of a minimum of 140 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check that the collector inside diameter is at least 140 mm.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the sample device shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Check that drain holes stay open during the spray test.

requirements.text: When used, drain wicks shall be tested in the device.
requirements.test_case: If drain wicks are fitted, test them in the device.

requirements.text: During the water spray test, the sample device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the rotation rate is 4.0±0.5 min-1.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these signalling or lighting functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp functions at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Check the spray test runs 12 h (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

requirements.text: After the rotation and the water spray are turned OFF, the device under test shall be allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
requirements.test_case: Allow 1 h drain with the cabinet door closed and verify the duration.

requirements.text: During the drain period of the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF.
requirements.test_case: Check rotation and spray are off during the drain period.

requirements.text: The RI of the device shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for standing water, including after tapping or tilting the device.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.test_case: After the drain period, inspect the device interior for moisture.

requirements.text: The dust exposure test chamber shall be charged with 3 to 5 kg of the test dust.
requirements.test_case: Verify a 3 to 5 kg dust charge in the test record.

requirements.text: The dust exposure test chamber shall have the capability of agitating the test dust by means of compressed air or blower fans in such a way that the dust is diffused throughout the chamber.
requirements.test_case: Check the chamber diffuses dust via compressed air or fans.

requirements.text: The interior of the dust exposure test chamber shall be cubical in shape in size 0.9 to 1.5 m per side.
requirements.test_case: Measure chamber dimensions (0.9 to 1.5 m per side).

requirements.text: The internal chamber volume of the dust exposure test chamber, not including a "hopper shaped" bottom, shall be 2 m3 maximum.
requirements.test_case: Check chamber volume is 2 m3 or less, excluding the hopper bottom.

requirements.text: The test dust used in the dust exposure test shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.test_case: Check the dust is cement per ASTM C 150-84.

requirements.text: The sample device, mounted on a test fixture with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows.
requirements.test_case: Mount the sample on a test fixture, measure and record the initial RI, expose it to dust per Annex 6 Part 3 2.3.4, then re-measure RI and compare to the limits.

requirements.text: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the sample device shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Check the openings are unobstructed during the test.

requirements.text: When drain wicks are used, they shall be tested in the device.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for drain wicks and test them in the device if present.

requirements.text: Devices with a length exceeding 600 mm shall be horizontally centred in the test chamber.
requirements.test_case: Measure the device length and centre it horizontally if over 600 mm.

requirements.text: The mounted sample device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
requirements.test_case: Check the sample is at least 150 mm from the chamber walls.

requirements.text: The test dust in the dust exposure test shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
requirements.test_case: Check agitation of 2 to 15 s every 15 min for 5 h.

requirements.text: The test dust in the dust exposure test shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: Verify the dust settles between agitations.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the RI of the sample device shall be measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2 after the test.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the sample device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior with a cotton cloth after the test.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Run the corrosion/humidity test and check photometry and colorimetry afterwards.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration of retro-reflective devices shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for essential metal parts, e.g. a metallised rear face, and inspect for tarnishing.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts.
requirements.test_case: Strip removable parts from the sample before the salt mist test.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the sample to salt mist for 2x24 h with a 2 h dry interval.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Check the construction for metal parts; if present, check the mist is atomised at 35±2 °C.

requirements.text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline solution used to produce the saline mist shall be obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: If metal parts are present, check the solution is 5% NaCl in distilled water with at most 0.02% impurities.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect for excessive corrosion after the test.

requirements.text: Before measuring, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
requirements.test_case: Check cleaning is documented before the RA measurement.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure RA at β2=5°, α=20' after 48 h recovery and compare with Table 9.

requirements.text: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not more than the value in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Compare the measured RA with the Table 10 limit.

requirements.text: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.test_case: Brush the rear side with a hard nylon brush.

requirements.text: After brushing, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
requirements.test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the rear face for 1 min.

requirements.text: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
requirements.test_case: Brush the rear side again with the same brush once evaporation is complete.

requirements.text: After the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink, the RI shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Cover the rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per 5.1.3.2.2.

requirements.text: The accelerated artificial weathering apparatus shall be capable to control temperature and relative humidity.
requirements.test_case: Check apparatus calibration records for temperature and humidity control.

requirements.text: The accelerated artificial weathering apparatus shall be equipped with a water spray system.
requirements.test_case: Check the apparatus has a water spray system.

requirements.text: The accelerated artificial weathering apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
requirements.test_case: Check the apparatus conforms to EN ISO 4892-1 and -2.

requirements.text: The water spray system of the accelerated artificial weathering apparatus shall be capable to spray a minimum of 0.3 ml/cm² within 5 minutes.
requirements.test_case: Measure spray of at least 0.3 ml/cm² in 5 min.

requirements.text: The spray water used in the accelerated artificial weathering test shall be in accordance to the requirements of EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
requirements.test_case: Check the water quality against EN ISO 4892-2:2013.

requirements.text: The test report of the weathering test shall specify the test method used.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report names the weathering method.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed for a period of 500 hours in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Expose samples for 500 h per Table A6-1 and re-measure RI and appearance.

requirements.text: The samples in the accelerated artificial weathering test shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Expose samples per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with Table A6-1 parameters and check performance afterwards.

requirements.text: For either the retro-reflective device or the sample unit of retro-reflective marking material, the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Apply 70% n-heptane/30% toluol mixture to the device and inspect.

requirements.text: After about five minutes, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and its illuminating surface shall be inspected visually.
requirements.test_case: Inspect visually after about 5 minutes.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and its illuminating surface must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Check for surface changes; only slight cracks are tolerated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer and illuminating surface with soaked cotton cloth.

requirements.text: After about 5 minutes, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and its illuminating surface shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: Clean surface after about 5 minutes.

requirements.text: After cleaning, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI photometrically after cleaning and compare to the minimum values.

requirements.text: A test sample smeared with a mixture of detergent lubricating oil and graphite shall be easily cleaned without damage to the retro-reflective surface when wiped with a mild aliphatic solvent such as n-heptane, followed by washing with a neutral detergent.
requirements.test_case: Smear with oil/graphite, wipe with n-heptane, wash with detergent, inspect for damage.

requirements.text: The cleaning wand in the power washing test shall be held at no greater angle than 45 degrees from perpendicular to the retro-reflective surface.
requirements.test_case: Check wand angle is no more than 45° from perpendicular.

requirements.text: The nozzle used in the power washing test shall be a 40-degree nozzle creating wide fan pattern.
requirements.test_case: Check that a 40-degree wide fan nozzle is used.

requirements.text: The tip of the cleaning wand in the power washing test shall be positioned at distance of 600 ± 20 mm away from the retro-reflective surface.
requirements.test_case: Check wand tip distance is 600 ± 20 mm.

requirements.text: The water/wash solution in the power washing test shall have a flow rate of 7 ± 1 l/min.
requirements.test_case: Verify flow rate is 7 ± 1 l/min.

requirements.text: The water/wash solution in the power washing test shall have a pressure of 8 ± 0.2MPa.
requirements.test_case: Verify pressure is 8 ± 0.2 MPa.

requirements.text: The water/wash solution in the power washing test shall have a temperature of 60 +0/-5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Verify temperature is 60 +0/-5 °C.

requirements.text: When subjected to a continuous spraying action for 60 seconds on the test component in its normal mounting conditions, under the set-up parameters (a) to (f), a test sample shall show no damage to the retro-reflective surface or delamination from the substrate or separation from the sample mounting surface.
requirements.test_case: Spray for 60 s in mounting conditions; check for damage or delamination.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed rear lamp for pointed or sharp parts and projections; check the geometry on the drawings.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the installed lamp edges, gaps and flanges for catching features.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the radius of curvature of any protruding edges with a radius gauge; it must be at least 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of protruding parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the protrusion height of the lamp parts and check that outward angles are blunted where the protrusion is 1.5 to 5 mm.

requirements.text: The hardness measurement of protruding parts of the external surface made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure Shore A hardness of any protruding TPE or silicone seal with the lamp installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
requirements.test_case: If a Shore A measurement is not feasible, document the comparable hardness method used and its results.

requirements.text: The lamps of the lighting and light-signalling devices shall be designed so that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect mounting design and test for maladjustment under normal use.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check installation and vibration retention of characteristics on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer for light-signalling devices shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Check the manufacturer's fitting instructions and compare with the installation.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure reference axis orientation on the vehicle.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices, with a tolerance of ±3° allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis angle to the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: Measure height and orientation with the vehicle unladen on a flat horizontal surface.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Check symmetry of the mounted pair about the median plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of the left and right units.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of both units of the pair.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of both units.

requirements.text: All logos on lamps that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect for non-manufacturer logos.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lenses for logos and count them on the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements of paragraph 5.5 shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle body shape and the symmetry of the installation.

requirements.text: When lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, shall be fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify colour, position, orientation and visibility of each function in the assembly.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with the others switched OFF.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp design and measure colour with the position lamp and the other function both ON.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Check that stop and indicator functions share no light source or apparent surface.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
requirements.test_case: Draw lines through the apparent surfaces and count colour borderlines.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
requirements.test_case: Check the apparent surfaces for overlap along the reference axis.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; this requirement shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the gaps between facing edges of adjacent parts (at most 75 mm).

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; this requirement shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected area against the circumscribing quadrilateral (at least 60%).

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the markings and measure the gap between facing edges (at most 75 mm).

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the markings and measure the 60% projection criterion.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings for Y and, if present, verify the 5.7.2.1 criteria.

requirements.text: The illumination of a band or strip lamp surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
requirements.test_case: Check that at least two light sources are placed near the strip ends.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be not less than 0.8 m long.
requirements.test_case: Measure the strip length (at least 0.8 m).

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp shape and symmetry about the median plane.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall extend on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the strip end to the vehicle's outer edge (at most 0.4 m).

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the maximum and minimum heights from the apparent surface extremes.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check whether visibility angles are reduced and, if so, measure the height from the H plane.

requirements.text: When referred to the distance between lamps, the position of a lamp as regards width shall be determined from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance between inner edges of the apparent surfaces.

requirements.text: When referred to the overall width, the position of a lamp as regards width shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure from the outermost edge of the apparent surface.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Observe the lamps ON and check for intentional intensity, colour or surface variation.

requirements.text: When the photometric characteristics of any lamp vary in relation to ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall comply with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Review the control electronics for intensity variation and verify limits.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed vehicle for direct red light visibility from the front; check the 0.25 cd intensity if in doubt.

requirements.text: The assessment of light visibility under paragraphs 5.10.1 and 5.10.2 shall take no account of lighting devices fitted for the interior lighting of the vehicle nor of reversing projections.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the visibility assessment excludes interior lighting and reversing projections.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observe within Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle per Annex 4 for direct visibility of the red lamp surfaces.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity toward the front, which must be no more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring and verify the lamps switch ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings for interdependent system (Y) and verify the light sources switch simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to verify the lamps and the reflector cannot be concealed.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of emitted light against the red limits.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Check the colour of emitted light against white chromaticity limits.

requirements.text: The light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of emitted light against the red limits.

requirements.text: The light reflected by the non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Check reflected light colour against red limits per the retro-reflector approval.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the installed devices per function against the individual specifications.

requirements.text: A lamp installed on a movable component shall meet the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation drawing for movable mounting.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, shall be installed on movable components only under the conditions set out in paragraph 5.18.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation drawing for movable mounting.

requirements.text: At all fixed positions of the movable components, the lamps on the movable components shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check position, visibility and photometry at all fixed positions.

requirements.text: Where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings and the movable-component arrangement.

requirements.text: When the movable component is in any fixed open position, additional lamps for the functions of paragraph 5.18. that are fitted and switched ON shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check the open-position lamp behaviour.

requirements.text: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s) of an interdependent lamp system used for the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18., the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Check the system design and mounting.

requirements.text: Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.test_case: Check the system design and mounting.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a normal position of use, the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Check for glare or discomfort with the component in non-normal positions.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the normal position(s) of use, the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify return position.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
requirements.test_case: Measure the apparent surface hidden by the movable component in each fixed position.

requirements.text: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the lamps indicated in paragraph 5.21. shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check that additional lamps switch ON when hidden.

requirements.text: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle for the user notice if hiding exceeds 50%.

requirements.text: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Check the communication form remark if hiding exceeds 50%.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp bearing an approval mark shall be deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.test_case: Check that each lamp operates with only a light source or fuse installed.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the light source type and replaceability.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of the light source referred to in paragraph 5.23.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle documentation for a replacement procedure.

requirements.text: Where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module design.

requirements.text: During replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure and check the dashboard tell-tale.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is used, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Check that the replacement device keeps its original safety function.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is used, the replacement function shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Check the circuit design for fail-safe replacement and compare colour, intensity and position.

requirements.text: In the entire intensity range, where rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: If variable intensity control is present, measure the intensities across the whole variation range and confirm that the prescribed ratio is maintained during transitions.

requirements.text: Where rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., the intensity of all the lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Check the spec for variable intensity control on the position and stop lamps; if present, verify that both vary together and proportionally under the 5.26.1/5.26.2 conditions.

requirements.text: Lamps with variable luminous intensity under paragraph 5.26 shall show no sharp variation of intensity during transition.
requirements.test_case: If intensity varies, record the intensity during transitions and check for sharp steps.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions.
requirements.test_case: Check the supply voltage documentation prepared for the Technical Service.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode, or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: Compare the voltage at the terminals with the approval documentation.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals in the vehicle's operating condition.

requirements.text: A report shall be attached to the approval documentation describing the methods used to demonstrate compliance and the results obtained.
requirements.test_case: Document check only.

requirements.text: The lamp's angles of geometric visibility shall have no obstacle on their inside to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the visibility angles for obstacles by inspection and drawings.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: If measuring close up, shift the observation direction parallel.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation for hidden surface and show photometry of the visible part.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp markings for Y and test visibility with all lamps operating.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of UN Regulation No. 48 when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marks and certificates of each device.

requirements.text: Light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for a logo; if present, check the R148 approval.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to UN Regulation No. 48 and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.
requirements.test_case: Check the light source type and approval documents of each lamp.

requirements.text: At both the type approval and the conformity of production verification, the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the LED substitute source marking.

requirements.text: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) shall be allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8 of UN Regulation No. 48 is present and positive.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the sources are substitute LED light sources and whether the 3.2.8 statement is positive.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.test_case: Check that the vehicle is fitted with a reversing lamp.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm, the reversing lamp installation shall be fitted with one mandatory reversing lamp device.
requirements.test_case: Count reversing lamp devices on the vehicle; exactly one is required.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check for a UN R23 or R148 approval mark or certificate on the lamp.

requirements.text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height above ground of the lamp's lowest and highest points on the vehicle.

requirements.text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm the reversing lamp is located at the rear.

requirements.text: For devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle α shall be 15° upwards, as defined in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility of 15° upwards per 2.10.7 on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: For devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle α shall be 5° downwards, as defined in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility of 5° downwards per 2.10.7 on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: If there are two devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° outwards and 30° inwards, as defined in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Count rear reversing devices; if two, check 45° outwards and 30° inwards.

requirements.text: If there is only one device installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β shall be 45° to right and to left, as defined in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Check horizontal visibility of 45° to right and left on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be designed so that it can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, engage reverse with the propulsion control in the operating position and confirm the lamp lights; with the control not in that position, confirm it does not light.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if the reverse gear is not engaged, or if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position that makes operation of the propulsion system possible.
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, select non-reverse gears and switch the propulsion control off, and confirm the lamp is off. Also disengage reverse while the lamp is lit and confirm it switches off.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation (UN R23/R148) for a tell-tale requirement and verify it if required.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle lighting installation drawing for S1/S2 stop lamps.

requirements.text: Stop lamps on all categories of vehicles shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for two S1/S2 stop lamps and one S3/S4 lamp.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate to UN R7 (02 series or later) or R148.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the apparent surface of S1 or S2 stop lamp devices in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle (max 400 mm).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check whether optional lamps are fitted; if so, measure the vertical spacing (at least 600 mm).

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamp devices shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground (350-1500 mm).

requirements.text: S1 or S2 stop lamp devices shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle to confirm it is at the rear.

requirements.text: For stop lamps of categories S1 or S2 mounted below 750 mm, measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above, the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify that the inward visibility is at least 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of categories S1 or S2 shall have geometric visibility extending 15° above and 15° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the category, then verify visibility of 15° above and 15° below the horizontal by goniometric check.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of categories S1 or S2 shall have geometric visibility extending 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the stop lamp category, then check the geometric visibility of 45° left and right of the longitudinal axis on the vehicle or by goniometer.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of categories S3 or S4 shall have geometric visibility extending 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the category; for S3/S4 verify visibility of 10° above and 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of categories S3 or S4 shall have geometric visibility extending 10° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the stop lamp category; for S3/S4 check the geometric visibility of 10° left and right of the longitudinal axis.

requirements.text: Where a stop lamp of category S1 or S2 is mounted below 750 mm, measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above, the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per 5.8.1; if below 750 mm, verify that the downward visibility is at least 5°.

requirements.text: Where an optional stop lamp of category S1 or S2 is mounted above 2,100 mm, measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above, the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per 5.8.1; if above 2,100 mm, verify that the upward visibility is at least 5°.

requirements.text: Stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the reference axis orientation on the vehicle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Operate the brake and check that all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamp tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the UN R7/R148 requirement and the tell-tale presence.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp's UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 approval marking and certificate, and that two lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; this condition does not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's outer edge (max 400 mm).

requirements.text: If the optional lamps are installed, they shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check whether optional lamps exist and, if so, that they are at least 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: In height, the rear position lamp shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lamp above the ground in the installed state (350-1500 mm).

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle in length.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to verify the lamp is at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check horizontal geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check vertical geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is used, verify the horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is used, verify the vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: If the alternative is used, check the unobstructed apparent surface is at least 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The electrical connection of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the wiring and verify it complies with paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be provided if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the component Regulation requires a failure tell-tale and, if so, test its function.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamp shall be combined with that of the front position lamps, except when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check that the rear position lamp tell-tale is combined with the front position lamp tell-tale.

requirements.text: A rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be fitted on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm a rear non-triangular retro-reflector is fitted.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Inspect for additional retro-reflecting materials and verify they do not impair the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be two in number, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings on the retro-reflectors and count the units fitted at the rear.

requirements.text: In width, the point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge on the installed vehicle; it must be 400 mm or less.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the retro-reflector's reference points above the ground (250 mm to 900/1200/1500 mm).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle in length.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall provide a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check that the horizontal visibility is 30° inwards and outwards using the installation drawing and a visibility check.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall provide a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above and below horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Check that the vertical visibility is 10° above and below horizontal using the installation drawing.

requirements.text: Where the rear retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward vertical angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height; if below 750 mm, verify the downward angle is at least 5°.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle wiring: on emergency braking, all stop lamps flash simultaneously if the function is fitted.

requirements.text: In the case where the non-textured outer lens is excluded and "7b" is the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2., function F1 shall not be transparent to function F2.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval drawing and declared light emitting surface for lens texture and the 7b declaration, then inspect that one function's lit area is not visible through another function's surface.
